commands.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit', '.agents/skills/foundvia-discovery/scripts/discovery_audit.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
r = m.fetch('https://foundvia.dev/sitemap.xml', 10, same_origin_only=True)
print('Sitemap index:', r['status'], r['error'], r['body'])
if r['status'] == 200:
    root = ET.fromstring(r['body'])
    children = [e.text.strip() for e in root.iter() if e.tag.split('}')[-1] == 'loc' and e.text]
    for child in children[:1]:
        if m.same_origin('https://foundvia.dev/', child):
            result = m.fetch(child, 10, same_origin_only=True)
            print('Child sitemap:', result['url'], result['status'], result['error'])
            if result['status'] == 200:
                parsed = ET.fromstring(result['body'])
                entries = [e.text.strip() for e in parsed.iter() if e.tag.split('}')[-1] == 'loc' and e.text]
                print('URL count:', len(entries))
                print('Homepage present:', any(m.equivalent_url('https://foundvia.dev/', e) for e in entries))
PY"
